annotations.title: Send your answers for a document

description: Use to send the answers for some or all sections of the document being read: `replies` is {"<section number>": {"Q1": {"status": "found", "value": ..., "quote": "verbatim from that section"}, ...}}, leaving out the questions a section does not answer, and {} for a section with nothing (so it counts as read). Replies can be sent a page at a time; a section sent again replaces its reply. With done=true the replies are checked and saved as the document's answers (an answer whose quote is not in its section is dropped; the result says how many). `model`: the model the assistant runs on, recorded with the answers. Returns what was kept and what is missing.

token.description: The lease token that came with it.
